result: Encrypted UEFI GUI installation and installed desktop validation passed using the Xfce live compatibility entry; default Plasma live installer rendering remains broken in this VM.

source.note: Snapshot used for the tested ISO, before this report and its documentation links were added.

vm.diagnostic_deviation: test_diagnostics=true enabled inside the live guest only, behind the disposable-VM guard; installed QEMU guest agent and serial/tty console parameters. No fixture requests or automatic login.
vm.installed_boots: Disk and UEFI variables only; no ISO, shared filesystem or host Nix store.
vm.final_state: Cleanly powered off with systemctl poweroff; QEMU process exited. Installed disk and UEFI variables retained under .work/luks-e2e-uefi/.

selection.encryption: LUKS2 root and swap, same separate disk passphrase

installation.driver: Real Genkan GUI, keyboard/pointer through QMP; review, typed erase confirmation, acknowledgement and Install
installation.helper_cleanup: No calamares-target mounts or genkan-* mappings after completion
installation.restart: Clicked Restart Now in Genkan; restarted QEMU with only the installed disk.

validation.wrong_disk_passphrase: Rejected by both systemd-cryptsetup units; system stayed locked. Correct passphrases then reached the greeter.
validation.normal_second_boot: One correct disk-passphrase entry unlocked both root and swap and reached the greeter.
validation.login: Separate login password entered at the graphical greeter; Aizome on first boot, Plasma Wayland on second boot.
validation.root: / and /nix/store backed by /dev/mapper/cryptroot (ext4); /nix/store is a read-only bind mount from that filesystem.
validation.containers: cryptroot and cryptswap both LUKS2, aes-xts-plain64, 512-bit key, Argon2id, 16 MiB payload offset, runtime discards flag. No persistent header flag.
validation.swap: Active 8 GiB swap on cryptswap; observed used swap in first session and active swap after reboot.
validation.trim: 4 KiB discard granularity through disk and both mappings; fstrim -v / succeeded on both installed boots (56.2 GiB and 56.1 GiB).
aizome_gui: Firefox launched from menu and rendered https://example.com
Hako opened Home and displayed cryptroot
Foot terminal launched and created/read ~/luks-persistence.txt as lukstest
Settei Network, Appearance and Displays pages
Yukimi Overview, Installed and Desktops pages read the actual installed system
plasma_gui: Selected Plasma (Wayland) at greeter and logged in
Read persistence file and displayed root mount and active swap in Konsole
validation.system_and_user_failed_units: Zero in both installed desktop sessions.
validation.configuration: Installed flake.lock matches ISO; generated configuration names outer LUKS UUIDs, inner root/swap UUIDs and allowDiscards=true. Login hash is root:root 0600 under root:root 0700 /etc/nixos-secrets.

issues.issue: Aizome was absent from the default respin.referenceDesktops list, although it is the default installer selection.
issues.evidence: Initial 8 GiB attempt exhausted live tmpfs during preparation, before disk erasure. A 16 GiB diagnostic retry began compiling Aizome and was cancelled before disk mutation. Added aizome to the ISO reference desktops, rebuilt the ISO, then completed the full 8 GiB GUI install. The Aizome runtime was present in the final ISO closure.

issues.issue: In the default Plasma live session, advancing Genkan from Welcome to Disk left stale Welcome graphics and translucent Disk content.
issues.evidence: Reproduced with standard VGA and with virtio GPU, including final ISO. Vulkan warnings were present; root cause not established. The official Xfce/X11 compatibility entry worked. Installed Plasma itself logged in and launched applications.

issues.issue: Filesystem option labels compressed in the encrypted Disk-page layout; the review showed the full filesystem name.
Initial disk serial failed the disposable-VM guard; changed it to RESPIN_TEST_ONLY. Early synthetic typing was too fast; slowed it and re-entered the fields. Neither was a production source fix.

limits: Full GUI install tested only on UEFI/ext4 with swap. Earlier component coverage of BIOS/ext4/Btrfs/XFS with and without swap is separate evidence.
No physical hardware or encrypted hibernation validation.
No installed-system update or Yukimi Apply operation; read-only configuration/package views were exercised.
No Secure Boot, TPM unlock or recovery-key workflow validation.

cleanup.note: Removed unreachable Nix paths, inactive incremental caches and this run's obsolete ISO; retained source, current ISO, installed VM disk and evidence. Host free space was 34 GiB initially and about 43 GiB after rebuilding and retaining the VM.

publication: No publication enabled or performed; no commit, merge or push.
